Train a sparse autoencoder on embeddings

Source: R/python.R
train_sae.Rd

A TopK SAE (hypothesaes, Python stage sae) trained on the rows marked train; the trained encoder then gives the activations of every row. NumPy and torch are seeded with seed right before training, so a run on the same device reproduces the SAE.

Usage

train_sae(
  E,
  M,
  K,
  seed = 7L,
  train = rep(TRUE, nrow(E)),
  dir = tempfile("saereg_sae_")
)

Arguments

E

Embeddings (documents x dimensions).

M

Number of features (decoder directions).

K

Features active per document.

seed

Seed of the training.

train

Logical, the rows the SAE is trained on (e.g. the training half). The others are only encoded.

dir

Run directory (a new temporary one by default); it keeps sae/sae.pt.

Value

A list: W (dimensions x M, unit-length decoder directions), activations (documents x M), dir.
